lines.text: December 4th, 1872. The British brigantine Dei Gratia spots a ship drifting aimlessly off the Azores.
lines.spoken: December 4th, 1872. The British brigantine Dei Gratia spots a ship drifting aimlessly off the Azores.
lines.hero: archival photograph lands; DECEMBER 4, 1872 • ATLANTIC OCEAN

lines.text: It was the Mary Celeste. Her sails were set, and her cargo of industrial alcohol was intact.
lines.spoken: It was the Mary Celeste. Her sails were set, and her cargo of industrial alcohol was intact.
lines.hero: archival photograph lands; MERCHANT SHIP • MARY CELESTE

lines.text: When crewmen boarded, they found warm tea, untouched personal belongings, and a ticking clock.
lines.spoken: When crewmen boarded, they found warm tea, untouched personal belongings, and a ticking clock.
lines.hero: archival photograph lands; ABANDONED IN HASTE

lines.text: Captain Benjamin Briggs, his wife, his two-year-old daughter, and seven crewmen had vanished.
lines.spoken: Captain Benjamin Briggs, his wife, his two-year-old daughter, and seven crewmen had vanished.
lines.hero: archival photograph lands; TEN SOULS MISSING

lines.text: To this day, not a single trace of them has ever been found.
